info.title: 11 Estates CRM — journeys (work management) API
info.description: Service S3 (HLD §2). Owns queues and call attempts, capacities, life curve, the Commercial axis of offers and demands, exits, sourcing requests, proposals, site visits, deals, lease renewals, notifications and watchlist tasks. Conventions: docs/04-lld/conventions.md. LLD: docs/04-lld/journeys.md. Events: contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml.

post.summary: Log a call or meeting outcome (C-08); drives life curve, attempts, retire
post.description: One transaction: insert call, update queue item (done / attempts), and by outcome: confirmed → life curve day 0 (+ Upcoming→Available if availableNow, Dormant demand → reactivated, New demand → Contacted); no_answer → attempt+1, reschedule next working day, 3rd consecutive → personUnreachable=true and item closed (offer) or moved to to_contact/unreachable (demand); already_gone / unwilling (offer only) → Inactive + offer.retired.v1. confirmed on an Inactive offer reactivates it (R-12; derived status, usually Available). Every call emits call.logged.v1 (records sets the unreachable flag from personUnreachable).

post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (UUID, 24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body

get.summary: Public proposal page for a share-link token (no staff auth)
get.description: Served through web's public route /p/{token} (no Supabase JWT; web forwards with a service token scoped to this route). Returns the frozen snapshot. Unknown token → 404 link-not-found; expired or revoked → 410 link-expired. Each open is recorded (count, time, salted IP hash). Accept: text/html returns the rendered page; application/json returns the snapshot. Response headers: Cache-Control: no-store, X-Robots-Tag: noindex, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.

post.summary: Relay unpublished outbox rows into consumer pgmq queues
post.description: Invoked every minute by Supabase pg_cron + pg_net and poked after commits. Claims up to 500 outbox rows (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, ordered by occurred_at), sends one copy per subscribed consumer queue (subscriptions from contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml) and sets published_at. Timeout 10 s: batch work, not on a user request path.
post.x-rate-limit: 1 call/min per job (pg_cron); internal only
post.x-idempotency: safe to re-run: work is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; events deduped on eventId
post.x-timeout-reason: batch relay of ≤500 outbox rows; internal, not a user request (R-5)

post.summary: Drain a pgmq queue owned by this service
post.description: Reads up to 100 messages (visibility timeout 60 s), dedupes on eventId via processed_events, applies each in its own transaction, deletes on success. After 5 failed reads a message moves to <queue>_dlq (alarm on depth > 0). Timeout 55 s: stays under the Hobby function limit; remaining messages are picked up by the next minute's call.
post.x-rate-limit: 1 call/min per job (pg_cron); internal only
post.x-idempotency: safe to re-run: work is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; events deduped on eventId
post.x-timeout-reason: consumer batch under the function limit; internal, not a user request (R-5)

post.summary: Run a scheduled job (one bounded batch; continues on the next call)
post.description:
Jobs:
- `life-curve-nightly` (02:00 IST daily; must finish by 04:00 IST): recompute day counts and stages for rows with nextChangeOn ≤ today; apply stage actions; Upcoming → Available on possession date; Expired demand → Dormant
- `demand-gap-refresh` (02:45 IST daily (+ incremental on events)): recompute open demand vs matching supply per (segment, dealType, micromarket) and source quality per sourceType
- `rank-refresh` (every 5 min): recompute should_call ranks for items whose inputs changed (dirty flag) or after a weights change
- `lease-renewal-scan` (05:00 IST daily): emit lease_renewal.due.v1 for renewals with dueOn ≤ today
- `dormant-revisit` (06:00 IST daily): put Dormant demands with revisitDate ≤ today into dormant_revisits
- `follow-up-reminders` (08:00 IST daily): notify owners of deals and SRQs overdue today
- `queue-counts-flush` (every minute): emit queue.counts_changed.v1 for users whose section counters changed since their last emit (debounce ≤ 1/min per user, R-18)
- `retention-purge` (Sunday 03:30 IST): purge notes/notifications/link opens/snapshots per retention rules (NFR-18, R-15)

Each call processes batches until a 50 s budget is used, records a cursor in job_runs and returns `done=false` if work remains; pg_cron calls again the next minute until `done=true`.
post.x-rate-limit: 1 call/min per job (pg_cron); internal only
post.x-idempotency: safe to re-run: work is claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; events deduped on eventId

x-schedules.life-curve-nightly: 02:00 IST daily; must finish by 04:00 IST

post.x-timeout-reason: bounded job batch (50 s budget) with continuation; internal (R-5)

staffViaWeb.description: Service token minted by web for a signed-in staff user (aud=<service>, sub=web, tid, 5 min), plus headers X-User-Id, X-User-Role, X-Tenant-Id. Services re-check role and tenant.

serviceToken.description: Service-to-service JWT (aud=<service>, sub=<caller>, tid, 5 min). Issued by web at POST /internal/v1/service-tokens; verify with web GET /.well-known/jwks.json (conventions R-2). Internal routes only.

cronSecret.name: X-Cron-Secret
cronSecret.description: Per-service secret used by Supabase pg_cron/pg_net for /internal/v1/relay, /internal/v1/drain/*, /internal/v1/jobs/*.

categoryKey.description: Pagdi uses the sale_secondary / sale_secondary_any key (D-12).

LifeCurve.description: Life curve of one offer or demand (BRD §4.5, PRD §4.1, D-12).

decisionMakerNote.description: PII possible (name/title of the decision maker)

competingTerms.description: Lost only; business terms, no PII, e.g. 'Powai, 2 months rent free'

QueueSummary.description: My queue header (P-01). plannedToday = all Must call + Should call up to max(0, capacity − mustOpen − callsLoggedToday).

summary.description: Generated from stored fields (label, micromarket, area, price); never contact PII

availableNow.description: Upcoming offer confirmed as available now → Available

notes.description: Free text. PII possible; never logged or put in events.

CallCreate.description: Call (or meeting) outcome (C-08). Offer outcomes: confirmed | no_answer | already_gone | unwilling. Demand outcomes: confirmed | no_answer. Fact edits (price, availability, areas, extra offer) are sent by web to records in parallel (HLD §5.2).

competingTerms.description: Business terms only, no names or phones

ExitRequest.description: C-16. Lost: reasonCode required, competingTerms optional. Dormant: revisitDate (default today + 60, A-41). Invalid: reasonCode required; flagPerson=true + personId asks records to flag the person (records consumes demand.exited.v1; the flag type follows reasonCode).

ProposalPatch.description: JSON Merge Patch; Draft or Ready only (not Sent). Changing options rebuilds the snapshot.

status.description: Preparing = content snapshot being built from records; Ready = PDF/link allowed

preparedFor.description: Generated label only, e.g. 'Office, Andheri East'

PublicProposal.description: Token-scoped snapshot (US-23). Includes building names, photos, built-up and carpet area, price, availability and the MahaRERA number. Never owner/broker contacts, unit or wing.

DealPatch.description: JSON Merge Patch. Stage moves forward only (Negotiation → Documentation → Stamp duty & registration → Closed). nextAction + followUpDate are required on every change while the deal is open. stage=Closed requires closingPriceInr (and agreedTerms.leaseMonths for Lease). Cancel uses POST .../cancel.

title.description: Codes and labels only, never contact PII

MarkReadRequest.description: Either ids or upTo (mark all up to a timestamp).

LifeCurveThresholds.description: Admin-editable thresholds per category (BRD §4.5 + D-12). Each value is the last day of the stage.

QueueWeights.description: Should call ranking weights (PRD §4.2). Weights are normalised by their sum.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID; 24 h replay window per user+route. Same key with a different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Row version for optimistic concurrency; mismatch → 412 version-mismatch.
